name: Guaire

attributes.attribute: father of Ébhlinne, the mountain goddess of Munster
dwelt in the Brú na Bóinne stone complex

sources: MacNeill, Máire. "The Festival of Lughnasa, Parts I and II." Dublin: Comhairle Bhéaloideas Éireann, 1982, 327-328.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Guaire was an Irish hero and the father of Ébhlinne, the mountain goddess of Munster. He lived far to the north in the stone complex called Brú na Bóinne on the River Boyne. A second Guaire was a generous king of Connacht. He sent food through the air to hermits in the nearby mountains. His castle stands at Kinvarra in County Galway. There the bard Senchán recovered the lost epic Táin Bó Cuailnge from the Otherworld.

okr.objective: Present both the hero and the generous king called Guaire.
key_results: Name the mountain goddess of Munster whose father was Guaire.
